landing.title: Private tools
landing.subtitle: Encrypted in your browser. No accounts and no logs.
landing.chat.title: Private chat
landing.chat.description: Talk to one other person. Messages are end-to-end encrypted and vanish when you close the page.
landing.secrets.title: Share a secret
landing.secrets.description: Send encrypted text through a link, with a password, an expiry time and a read limit.
language.label: Language
common.networkError: Could not connect. Check your connection and try again.
secrets.create.description: It is encrypted in your browser. We only store ciphertext we cannot read.
secrets.create.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. If you lose it, nobody can recover the secret.
secrets.create.failed: The secret could not be created. Try again.
secrets.created.notice: Send the link and the password through different channels. Whoever has only one of them cannot read anything.
secrets.created.limits: It expires in {minutes} min or after {views} read(s), whichever comes first.
secrets.read.title: Secret shared with you
secrets.read.description: Enter the password given to you by whoever sent you this link.
secrets.read.failed: Wrong password or secret not available.
secrets.read.invalidLink: This link is not valid. Check that you copied all of it.
secrets.read.warning: Copy what you need. You may not be able to see it again.
chat.description: Generate a code, share it with the other person along with a password and both join. End-to-end encrypted, with no history.
chat.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Both of you must use the same code and password.
chat.reloadWarning: If you reload or close this page, the conversation is lost and cannot be recovered.
chat.undelivered: Your message was not delivered because the other person is not connected.
chat.status.roomFull: This room already has two participants.
chat.status.compromised: The other person could not be verified. The conversation was closed for safety.
chat.invitation: Share this code and the password through different channels. The other person needs both.
chat.encrypted: End-to-end encrypted: only you and the other person can read these messages. The server neither stores nor can see them.
